rationale: MGNI has gapped up ~13% on a strong earnings beat and is currently sitting at the absolute top of today's range (100th percentile) with the last candle showing a sharp surge to $27.16 on heavy volume — momentum is clearly upward but the stock is extended well above VWAP ($26.47) and the 9-EMA ($26.04), making a long entry at this level high-risk for a pullback. A short against a strong earnings catalyst with the stock still accelerating into new highs is equally dangerous. The wide bid-ask spread (99 bps) and the already-committed short in BABA further reduce the attractiveness of adding risk here; the setup lacks a clean, defined entry with favorable risk/reward in either direction.
